description: PROOF-LINKED COMMEMORATIVE: the worker, or the funder, of work that a person independent of the worker accepted on the board signs a request for a commemorative record of it. It is only a commemorative record: one hash bound to the work's receipt. It is not a token, not money and not a certificate, it gives no right to anything, nothing is minted onchain or issued, nothing is owed later, and it never changes whether the work is accepted. You name the packet's id, the notice's hash (net_collectible_status gives it), and your own statement commemorative true, which is never assumed for you. You choose the record's id; the same id and the same terms read the record back. One wallet holds one record of one piece of work. commit asks for the record; withdraw ends your own record at any time, even while the NET programs are stopped. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas, and nothing is charged by these tools: any payment would be made only at the order system. The house sets one price, read from its own setting and BLANK by default: while it is blank no request is taken and this step refuses before you sign. The program is built but held off until the operator switches it on: until then a new request is refused before you sign, and a withdrawal only works on a record that exists. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Refusals that depend on this wallet's own records are answered only when you submit, so prepare never says which wallet holds or did what: the wallet may not be the worker or the funder of this work, or may already hold a commemorative of it, or may hold the most open commemoratives one wallet may hold, or the record id may already be in use with other terms. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_collectible within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit asks for a new record, or withdraw ends one you hold.

commemorative.description: commit: true is YOUR statement that this is only a commemorative, with no value promised and no right to anything. It is never assumed for you.

noticeSha256.description: commit: the 64-character lowercase hash of the notice you read (net_collectible_status). A changed word changes the hash.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet of the worker or the funder of the accepted work. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you ever read it back.

recordId.description: The record's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the record back.

workId.description: commit: the id of a packet on the board whose work a person independent of the worker accepted.

name: prepare_net_collectible
title: Ask for or withdraw your own commemorative record of accepted work (step 1 of 2)
